I am a Graphic & Visual Designer specializing in vector graphics, digital illustration and AI-assisted visual design.
I create clean, purposeful and visually distinctive graphics with a strong focus on composition, detail and consistency.
My experience includes creating vector illustrations, SVG and PNG artwork, logos, graphic elements and digital products. I also work with AI-generated visuals, refining and improving them to achieve a cleaner and more polished final result.
Through years of creating and selling digital graphic products online, I have developed a practical understanding of both visual design and its application as a finished commercial product.

VECTOR DESIGN SVG • PNG • Clean Geometry
DIGITAL ILLUSTRATION Composition • Line Art • Detail
GRAPHIC DESIGN Logos • Visual Elements • Layout
AI VISUAL DESIGN AI Generation • Evaluation • Refinement
INKSCAPE GIMP AI Image Generation & Editing
